value.rationale: The canonical maximal nilpotent matrix algebra is a motivated natural object with a nontrivial three-dimensional square. Its ordered product-word fiber distribution is a complete multiplicative invariant, not a sample of values or previously known image. The four strata show two distinct noncentral support classes as well as a zero vs central distinction, quantitative data not supplied by the image theorem or commutator-fiber distribution. The explicit distribution is useful as the exact convolution of two uniform measures on the algebra and for distinguishing nilpotent semigroup multiplication behavior.
